Ngươi lặn lội lên tận đây chỉ để chết tr: You came all this way just to die in the snow?
Bà nhận giáp của Ma giáo. Bà cũng là ngư: You took the cult's armor. Are you one of them?

Cầm lấy tấm bản đồ này. Mong ngươi đến k: Take this map. I hope you're in time.

Quả là đại quân. Phải phá chỗ này trước: A true army. I must break it before they march on the Central Plains.
Một mình mà dám vào thành ta? Gan lớn đấ: You enter my city alone? Bold. Let's see if your nerve is as hard as my blade!

Giáo chủ... sẽ không tha cho ngươi... Tổ: The Cult Master... won't spare you... the headquarters is in Black Moon Gorge, to the north...
Đại quân tan rã. Con đường tới tổng đàn: The army scatters. The road to the cult's headquarters lies open.
Hẻm núi Hắc Nguyệt, lửa đỏ rực trời. Đây: Black Moon Gorge, fires blazing to the sky. The headquarters of the Black Moon Cult.
Having come this far, there's no turning back.
Ta đã theo dõi ngươi từ chân núi Thiếu T: I've watched you since the foot of Shaoshi. You're the only one who made it this far.

Chaos? I only hasten the inevitable. The five great sects squabble over empty fame — the jianghu needs a master.
Nhưng ta cũng chỉ là quân cờ. Thắng ta đ: But I'm only a pawn. Beat me, then climb Tianzhu Peak and ask the one moving the pieces.
You really are strong... the one who gave my orders... awaits you at the tournament on Tianzhu Peak.
Ma giáo sụp đổ, nhưng câu hỏi lớn nhất v: The cult has fallen, but the biggest question remains unanswered.
Đỉnh Thiên Trụ, quần hùng tề tựu luận võ: On Tianzhu Peak the greatest fighters gather. One of them is behind it all.
Phải thắng từng người, cho tới khi kẻ đó: I must beat them one by one until that person shows their face.
Cuối cùng ngươi cũng tới. Ta là kẻ đã dự: At last you've come. I am the one who rebuilt the Black Moon Cult.
Vì sao? Người được tôn là Thiên Hạ Đệ Nh: Why? You're honored as First Under Heaven.
Vì ba mươi năm không ai đủ sức thách đấu: Because for thirty years no one could challenge me. I made chaos to find a worthy rival... and I've found one.
Hay... hay lắm. Giang hồ từ nay là của c: Good... very good. From now on the jianghu belongs to you, the young.
Âm mưu của Hắc Nguyệt Thần Giáo chấm dứt: The Black Moon Cult's plot is over. Your name rings across the land.
Nhưng giang hồ chưa bao giờ ngừng sóng g: But the jianghu is never calm. The Trial Tower and the Duel stage still await you.

Dấu vết dẫn tới một thung lũng không có: The trail leads to a valley on no map, covered in silver moonlight like mist.
Hắc Nguyệt đã tan, vậy kẻ nào còn treo ấ: The Black Moon is gone — so who still hangs the crescent seal?

Ngươi tỉnh táo quá... Mộng của ta vỡ rồi: You're too awake... my dream is broken. The others will wake at dawn.
Nhưng những cơn ác mộng Nguyệt Cung gieo: But the nightmares the Moon Palace sowed still haunt every region you've crossed.

Cần điều khiển (trái): đi / lùi; đẩy lên:
Joystick (left): walk / back off; push up = jump; pull down = crouch.
Hold BACK to block (crouch + back blocks low attacks).

Punch / Kick: tap repeatedly for combos.
Forward + Punch/Kick: lunging attack.  Crouch + Kick: leg sweep.
Dodge: back-step (brief invulnerability).  Forward + Dodge: dash.
Forward + Dodge up close: Grab (throw, breaks guard).

Skills cost Qi (blue bar).
Hits can cancel straight into a skill.

Pressure points: high hits = Arms (weaker attacks), low = Legs (slow, no jump/dash), mid = Dantian (no Qi regen, no Ultimate). Enough build-up seals for 5 s; buff / heal skills break the seal.
Insight: block, dodge or counter other sects' skills to slowly learn them.

[b]Điều khiển[/b]\n• Cần điều khiển bên:
[b]Controls[/b]
• Left joystick: walk forward / back. Push up to jump, pull down to crouch.
• Hold [b]back[/b] to block. Crouch + back blocks low attacks (sweeps).
• Overhead and airborne attacks must be blocked [b]standing[/b].
• [b]Punch / Kick[/b]: tap repeatedly for combos.
• Forward + Punch/Kick: lunge.  Crouch + Punch: low attack.  Crouch + Kick: sweep.
• [b]Dodge[/b]: back-step with a moment of invulnerability. Forward + Dodge: dash.
• Forward + Dodge up close: [b]Grab[/b] — throw, breaks guard.
• The three [b]skill[/b] slots cost Qi (blue bar). Hits can cancel straight into a skill.

[b]Jianghu Journey[/b]
• 7 regions of 6 fights each; the last is the boss. Win 2 rounds to pass.
• ★ win · ★★ 50%+ HP left · ★★★ win without losing a round.
• Level up for potential points (Strength, Agility, Inner Power, Constitution) and skill points.
• Arena: back-to-back fights, foes get stronger, rewards grow with your streak.
• Training: hit the dummy to practice moves, no risk.

[b]Keyboard (PC)[/b]: A/D move, W jump, S crouch, J punch, K kick, L dodge, U/I/O skills.
